weekRule.description: week numbering rule, using the sap/base/i18n/date/CalendarWeekNumbering enum. ISO_8601 (Mon start, week with 1st Thursday) | WesternTraditional (Sun start, week with Jan 1) | MiddleEastern (Sat start) | MondayJan1 (Mon start, week with Jan 1 - not part of the UI5 enum)

fontFamily.description: CSS font-family. empty = inherit from SAC theme (Default)

fontSize.description: font size in px. 0 = inherit from SAC theme (Default)

fontColor.description: text color as hex. empty = inherit from SAC theme (Default)

accentColor.description: accent color as hex. applies to the calendar icon, the icon pressed background, the calendar popup header and arrows, and the selected day/month background. empty = inherit from SAC theme (Default)

minDateVal.description: The minimum Date value that can be selected. (optional)

maxDateVal.description: The maximum Date value that can be selected. (optional)

getDateVal.description: get the selected date. week mode returns the first day of that week, month mode the first day of that month. returns undefined when no date is selected

getFormattedVal.description: get the formatted string for the selected value. day: yyyy.MM.dd | week: YYYY.ww (YYYY = week-based year, may differ from calendar year) | month: yyyy.MM

setFormattedVal.description: set the value from a formatted string, interpreted by the current dateMode. day: 2026.08.19 | week: 2026.34 | month: 2026.08. separators are ignored, so 20260819 / 2026-W34 also work. an empty string clears the value

getDateMode.description: get the current date mode. day | week | month

setDateMode.description: switch the date mode. if the current format does not fit the new mode, the mode default is used instead

getWeekRule.description: get the week numbering rule. ISO_8601 | WesternTraditional | MiddleEastern | MondayJan1

setWeekRule.body: if (rule === 'ISO_8601' || rule === 'WesternTraditional' || rule === 'MiddleEastern' || rule === 'MondayJan1') { this.weekRule = rule; }

convertDateToWeek.description: convert a date to its week. returns a week string. uses the format property when it is a week pattern, otherwise YYYY.ww. returns an empty string for an invalid input

convertStrDateToWeek.description: convert a date string to its week. returns a week string. uses the format property when it is a week pattern, otherwise YYYY.ww. separators are ignored, so 2025.12.01 / 2025-12-01 / 20251201 are all accepted. returns an empty string for an invalid input

convertWeekToFirstDate.description: get the first day of the given week, following the weekRule property. returns a date string. uses the format property when it is a date pattern, otherwise yyyy.MM.dd. separators are ignored, so 2025.12.01 / 2025-12-01 / 20251201 are all accepted. returns an empty string for an invalid input

convertWeekToEndDate.description: get the last day of the given week, following the weekRule property. returns a date string. uses the format property when it is a date pattern, otherwise yyyy.MM.dd. separators are ignored, so 2025.12.01 / 2025-12-01 / 20251201 are all accepted. returns an empty string for an invalid input

convertMonthToEndDate.description: get the last day of the given month. leap years are handled. returns a date string. uses the format property when it is a date pattern, otherwise yyyy.MM.dd. separators are ignored, so 2025.12.01 / 2025-12-01 / 20251201 are all accepted. returns an empty string for an invalid input

getMinimumDateVal.description: get the date minimum. (might return undefined if value is not set)

getMaximumDateVal.description: get the date maximum. (might return undefined if value is not set)

onChange.description: Called when the user changes the selected date.
